question: World Zoonoses Day is observed every year on _______ to create awareness on zoonotic diseases, how to prevent them, and what actions to take when exposed.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 July**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Zoonoses day** is celebrated to **commemorate** the **first vaccination** administered against a **Zoonotic disease**.
 
• The **first vaccination** was administered by French biologist **Louis Pasteur** on **6th July 1885**.
